FROM docker.m.daocloud.io/jenkins/inbound-agent:latest-jdk17

USER root

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl \
    unzip \
    zip \
    gnupg \
    ca-certificates \
    apt-transport-https \
    maven && \
    curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/docker-archive-keyring.gpg && \
    echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/docker-archive-keyring.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian trixie stable" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null && \
    apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y docker-ce-cli && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN su - jenkins -c "curl -s \"https://get.sdkman.io\" | bash" && \
    su - jenkins -c "bash -c 'source /home/jenkins/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && yes | sdk install java 11.0.23-tem'"

RUN mkdir -p /home/jenkins/.m2/repository && \
    chown -R jenkins:jenkins /home/jenkins

COPY settings.xml /home/jenkins/.m2/settings.xml

RUN chown jenkins:jenkins /home/jenkins/.m2/settings.xml

ENV MAVEN_OPTS="-Dmaven.repo.local=/home/jenkins/.m2/repository"

USER jenkins

WORKDIR /build

    apt-get install -y docker-ce-cli && \

    apt-get update && \

FROM gcr.m.daocloud.io/kaniko-project/executor:debug AS kaniko
FROM m.daocloud.io/docker.io/library/openjdk:11.0.11-jdk AS jdk11
FROM docker.m.daocloud.io/jenkins/inbound-agent:latest-jdk17

USER root

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl unzip zip maven coreutils && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY --from=jdk11 /usr/local/openjdk-11 /usr/local/openjdk-11

RUN ln -s /usr/local/openjdk-11 /opt/jdk11 && \
    chmod -R +x /opt/jdk11/bin

COPY --from=kaniko /kaniko/executor /usr/local/bin/kaniko
COPY --from=kaniko /kaniko/docker-credential-gcr /usr/local/bin/
COPY --from=kaniko /kaniko/docker-credential-ecr-login /usr/local/bin/
COPY --from=kaniko /kaniko/docker-credential-acr-env /usr/local/bin/

RUN mkdir -p /kaniko/.docker /home/jenkins/.m2/repository && \
    chown -R jenkins:jenkins /home/jenkins /kaniko

COPY settings.xml /home/jenkins/.m2/settings.xml

RUN chown jenkins:jenkins /home/jenkins/.m2/settings.xml

ENV DOCKER_CONFIG=/kaniko/.docker
ENV MAVEN_OPTS="-Dmaven.repo.local=/home/jenkins/.m2/repository"

USER jenkins

WORKDIR /build
